chapter: Arranging for other bandleaders and closing talk
title: Tuba and banjo replaced by string bass and guitar
summary: By his arranging days tuba became obsolete and guitar and string bass gave a more mellow sound and better beat.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Yeah. Concerning arranging itself, let's see -- by the time you are really starting arranging, they had begun pretty much to shift on over to string bass, hadn't -- they weren't still using tuba or --
And same way with banjo -- was either dropped or guitar.
Yeah, replaced it. It gave it a more mellow sound, plus the fact that the string bass, you know, gave it a better beat, especially if the guy could play, and guys were switching over like mad.
